metadata.title: Semiconductors and tech-hardware names are off to a strong start on Wednesday - MarketWatch

content.text:
8 min ago
Semiconductors and tech-hardware names are off to a strong start on Wednesday
Chip stocks and tech hardware names like Dell were off to a strong start on Monday. Semiconductor stocks such as AMD and Intel were among the strongest performers on the S&P 500, helping to claw back recent losses.
The top-performing stock in the index was Lumentum Holdings, another AI-related hardware play. The company specializes in optical and photonics components that data centers need to function.
